description: Request a free reviewed listing correction with X-Mekler-Listing-Control, current revision, a fresh private requester_key and exact changes. Reuse that same requester_key and identical body after an uncertain response; it pins one request, and changed input conflicts. A verified private email is required. Name/description/category, a same-origin website URL and the full replacement active endpoint list (up to 50 GET/POST paths) are supported. Publish the returned change-bound HTTPS verification file and confirm update_id within 72 hours through confirm-ownership-proof. Confirmation queues review; it never publishes raw submitted text. Pending reviews expire after seven days with a private outcome. Removed-route history is retained. action status with listing_id or origin reads private controls; optional request_id reads that correction outcome. Private data never enters public directory projections. Never signs payments.
name: request_listing_update
